title: MPP attack surface
caption: Where attacks land and which rule answers them. Three of the server items are past SDK advisories, now fixed.
alt: Flowchart in four zones. Client: overpay by a malicious server, answered by client checks; leaked credential, answered by TLS and never logging. Path: a proxy caching a Payment-Authorization response, answered by Cache-Control private or no-store; spoofed discovery data, answered by treating the 402 challenge as authoritative. Server and SDK: replay of a consumed id or SPT, fee payer drained by padded calldata, close voucher equal to settled amount. Channel: never-expiring channel left open; unresponsive server at close, answered by forced close after 15 minutes.
